WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes
), station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT AVG(sa.avg_bandusage) AS mean_station_average,
       AVG(sa.avg_bandusage - b.avg_bandusage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM station_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE sa.avg_bandusage > b.avg_bandusage;
